description: Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware in August 1933 under the name Bristol-Myers Company as successor to a New York business started in 1887 and renamed Bristol-Myers Squibb Company in 1989 as a result of a merger, operates in a single segment engaged in the discovery, development, licensing, manufacturing, marketing, distribution and sale of innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases. Its principal strategy is to combine the resources, scale and capability of a large pharmaceutical company with the speed, agility and focus on innovation typically found in the biotech industry, focused on discovering, developing and delivering transformational medicines for patients facing serious diseases in areas where it believes it can make a meaningful difference, including oncology, hematology, immunology, cardiovascular, neuroscience and other areas.
